title.zh: 可加退出承担的共同资金界
title.en: Joint funding of additive exit obligations

claim.zh: 前 n 项自然数承担的每个所选子集都不超过 reserve，当且仅当全部承担之和不超过 reserve。
claim.en: Every selected subset of the first n natural-number obligations fits reserve iff their full sum fits reserve.

hypotheses.zh: 承担为非负自然数且可加，reserve 为同一份可用支持。
hypotheses.en: Obligations are nonnegative additive natural numbers; reserve is the same available support pool.

correspondence.zh: 数值代表所声明的退出工作，不是通用伦理价值；真实义务与储备需独立核实。
correspondence.en: Numbers represent declared exit work, not universal ethical value; actual obligations and reserves require independent correspondence.

detail.zh: 支持身份与可加总量不同，没有已证通用转换。
detail.en: Support identity differs from additive quantity; no verified general adapter.

detail.zh: 静态总量条件不提供动态方案的观察与作用覆盖。
detail.en: A static total does not supply a dynamic plan’s observation and effect coverage.

detail.zh: 各项分别可负担不推出共同可负担；两个二单位承担可以竞争同一二单位储备。
detail.en: Individual affordability does not imply joint affordability: two two-unit obligations can compete for one two-unit reserve.

limitations.zh: 各项分别可负担不推出共同可负担；两个二单位承担可以竞争同一二单位储备。
limitations.en: Individual affordability does not imply joint affordability: two two-unit obligations can compete for one two-unit reserve.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 可加退出预算直接复用；其他支持类型需明确转换或另证。
next_delta.en: Reuse for additive exit budgets; other support types require a stated translation or separate proof.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
